messages:
jordan: Quick sync — telemetry is showing a steady increase in v1 failures for long-sequence requests (esp > 2k tokens). I'm thinking we try a Console-led "soft-hide" for v1: hide v1 from the "create route" dropdown for new routes, but keep pinned/legacy routes working. Thoughts?

leah: sounds reasonable. How do we make the risk obvious to tenants? We should show a per-route heatmap (error rate + seq len distribution) before we let them hide.

pranav: main infra concern: capacity shift to v2 could cause transient throttles. Can Console surface an estimated quota/capacity delta when you flip soft-hide?

jordan: proposal sketch: Console adds a per-tenant "soft-hide legacy runtime" toggle. When enabled it does:
- spin up a sampling probe (default 1%) that mirrors requests to v2 for compatibility signals (tokens, error delta, quality metrics)
- block new route creation for v1 in the UI (existing pinned routes continue)
- surface a heatmap and an "estimated cost/latency impact" panel
- offer a one-click bulk unpin assist to migrate pinned routes

sam: two concerns: 1) probes counting against quota will skew billing and can cause noisy spikes; 2) autoswitching users without explicit consent could trigger support tickets. We should rate-limit probes and put them in a non-billable probe bucket by default. Also require tenant opt-in for auto-unpin.

jordan: agreed on opt-in. For the probe accounting: what if we mirror but mark those tokens with a "probe" tag that doesn't count toward normal billing counters? Example flag: feature.console.soft_hide.probe_bucket = true

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: feature flag staged: feature.console.soft_hide.v1 -> targeting staging-1 and canary-ops

pranav: mirror-probes-that-dont-bill is doable, but Ops will want a mirrored billing-safe counter for capacity planning. i.e. we keep an internal "probe_volume" metric that shows up in dashboards but doesn't get billed. That way capacity autoscaling uses real demand.

leah: UI copy suggestion: "Hide legacy v1 from new route creation (existing pinned routes unaffected). Run compatibility probes to estimate migration risk. Requires tenant opt-in to auto-migrate pinned routes." Also add a small inline tooltip: "Probes are sampled requests that do not count against your billing by default."

jordan: nice. For telemetry thresholds, propose alerts: fail-rate increase >5% on probe vs baseline OR perplexity drift > 10% triggers a soft-hide rollback and an ops alert.

sam: add an autoscaling guard — if probe indicates >10% of tenant traffic would move to v2 and v2 capacity usage would cross 70% cluster threshold, pause auto-unpin and surface a capacity reservation suggestion.

jordan: I'll mock up a tiny PR w/ wireframes and the backend contract:
```
feature.console.soft_hide.enabled = boolean
feature.console.soft_hide.probe_rate = 0.01
feature.console.soft_hide.probe_bucket = true
feature.console.soft_hide.auto_unpin_optin = boolean
```

pranav: looks good. Can you add a step in the runbook to revert probe sampling to 0% and disable the flag if we hit the alert?

jordan: yes — runbook item: "disable flag, set probe_rate=0, notify tenants, rollback any auto-unpins". I'll open the PR and tag @pranav @leah @sam for review. :thumbsup:

leah: thanks — can you also add a small telemetry widget that exposes per-route expected token delta so customer success can pre-warn large spenders?

jordan: will do. Opening PR now.
